data.title: 椎名真昼 · 抱枕旁的读书便签
data.description: 傍晚客厅里，真昼穿奶油色麻花毛衣和浅蓝家居长裤，盘腿坐在沙发上。她把白熊抱枕搁在膝间，认真将一张叶形书签夹进读到一半的书，发现夹反后忍不住轻轻笑了。
data.action: 盘腿坐在抱枕旁，把夹反的叶形书签转正，轻轻一笑。
data.mood: 私人空间卸下防备、依赖感
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina sits cross-legged on the sofa in a cream cable-knit sweater and pale-blue lounge trousers, a white-bear cushion on her lap. She carefully inserts a leaf-shaped bookmark, then laughs softly after noticing it is reversed. The medium portrait includes the partly read book and sofa arm. A warm floor lamp reveals the knit ridges and bookmark edge, with soft lap shadows and a subdued living-room corner behind.
